title: Banff Town Walking Tour Includes Refreshment and Sweet Treat
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
HISTORY, CULTURE, NATURE & MORE - THE PERFECT "WELCOME TO BANFF" TOUR! 
* Explore the breathtaking scenery of Banff on a 2-hour walking tour. Stroll through the streets of Banff and learn about the town’s history and surroundings from your guide. Enjoy a sweet treat and a refreshing drink along the way!
* Meet your guide in the heart of the town and spend the next couple of hours enjoying all the culture, history, nature, and joy that Banff has to offer! As you walk, listen to fascinating insights that breathe life into the town’s history and surroundings.
* Even if you think you know Banff, this tour promises to shine a new light on this gem of the Rockies.
* Bring your camera for gorgeous photos as the scenery is like no other!
